summary: P12 Test package: run the real BiliDili dual-host file-change/evolution parity verification after the accepted Alembic InProcessFileChangeHandler and AlembicPlugin HostAgentFileChangeHandler source renames.

targetTasks.summary:
Window/repository: Test only. Read parent AGENTS.md, Test/AGENTS.md, .wakeflow-active/index.md, .wakeflow-active/current/workspace-current-status.md, this state root, Design P12 lines 863-867 and §12.3 Chain 6, freeze register, evidence/p12-file-change-handler-rename-controller-review.md, both P12 target results, and this task package/delivery. Confirm identity as Test before running.

Goal: real BiliDili P12 evolution parity after source-package acceptance. Source pins to record and verify before test: Alembic 91a254901ab5a7367d9965d9ab5be9fdbd4595e1, AlembicPlugin a1bbabd997c06dda469b043047690a4b6e91e19b, AlembicCore 99a7cf10d82056cd860eb0a1d9544662e3735b08 unless the state root has a newer accepted pin. Use the real BiliDili workspace directly; no sandbox copy. Preserve configured providers: DeepSeek generation and local Qwen/Ollama embedding. Do not edit Alembic, AlembicPlugin, AlembicCore, BiliDili, Test source, provider config, package versions, freeze literals, or unrelated ~/.asd roots. Do not manually edit SQLite rows.

Before any rebuild/destructive operation, prove the R-2 root safety triple: BiliDili projectRoot, BiliDili dataRoot, and this state root. Run SQLite integrity checks and record source/provider pins. Use the documented alembic_bootstrap rebuild/reset flow between runs when needed, constrained to the BiliDili data root.

Required host-agent path: drive a governed-tool/commit-driven file-change scenario on BiliDili after a committed covered-source change. Success requires Plugin output `data.unifiedEvolution.evidenceGate.verdict='routed'`, stable `PluginOpportunisticEvolution` literals (`plugin-opportunistic`, `daemon-file-change`, `defer-to-alembic-service` when applicable), and `evolution_proposals` moving 0->>=1 with `source='file-change'` for the changed source.

Required in-process path: drive the corresponding Alembic daemon/reactive file-change path (`POST /api/v1/evolution/file-changed` or the documented watcher route). Success requires a `ReactiveEvolutionReport` or equivalent raw runtime JSON/log evidence and an equivalent `evolution_proposals` row through the same Core Gateway with `source='file-change'`.

Parity predicate: normalize volatile ids/timestamps/round-driving fields and compare host-agent vs in-process proposal effects. Success requires diff == empty for action/recipe/source-ref semantics, non-empty proposal evidence, preserved frozen literals (`file-change`, `evolving`, `decaying`, producerKind values), and no 0-vs-0 pass. Also capture sweep evidence showing `[EvolutionMaintenanceSweep] periodic sweep completed` and the in-flight guard remains effective when the sweep is involved.

Block if root/provider pins mismatch, SQLite integrity fails, the scenario cannot produce a covered-source change, either path is empty, proposal source changes from `file-change`, parity diff remains non-empty, rebuild/reset would touch a non-BiliDili root, or manual data mutation would be required. Backfill TargetResultEnvelope with report path, summary JSON, raw command/log/runtime/DB artifacts, before/after SQL snippets, root/provider pins, parity diff artifact, PASS/BLOCKED verdict, residual risks, and next recommendation. Do not accept P12/G4/G6/P13/whole-demand completion; controller decides.
